argv.description: [<absolute claude-session path>, 'exec', '--session-id', <id>, '--run', <n>] (<n> the pending run); place it in a terminal or process.

run.description: The pending run start created, which the argv adopts (1 for a new session or fork; the next run for start --resume).

expires_at.description: The pending run ends not-started (never_adopted) unless adopted before this time (lost_grace after start).

required_env_names.description: Names (never values) the adopting process should have: the claude_auth_env names in use, the kind's env.allow names and the env.set names. PATH must contain claude (claude-session is run by the absolute argv[0]).

env_inherit.description: Whether the session inherits the adopting process's environment beyond required_env_names (kind env.inherit after flags).

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings (e.g. unknown kind fell back to the review profile; third-party-reading run not sandboxed).
